title: 리딩인사이드 스타터 UNIT 06 Cooperation 문장
source: Reading Inside Starter Answer Key — 구문 해설 인용문 + 워크북 WRITING TEST 정답 청크(해석은 교재 해석 발췌)

grammar.topic: 부정대명사 one·ones와 대명사 it / 원급 비교 as+원급+as
grammar.evidence: R1 Check Up: one · R2 Check Up: This sweater is as big · WB GRAMMAR TEST A(big·as·ones·it) B(one·They·ones·it) C(as old as Amy·as hot as that tea·as fast as that car)

sentences.title: Cooperating for Honey
sentences.en: Some animals benefit from having a special relationship with other animals.
sentences.ko: 어떤 동물들은 다른 동물들과 특별한 관계를 맺는 것으로부터 이익을 얻는다.

sentences.title: Cooperating for Honey
sentences.en: But have you ever heard of one between humans and birds?
sentences.ko: 하지만 당신은 인간과 새와의 관계에 대해 들어본 적이 있는가?

sentences.title: Cooperating for Honey
sentences.en: Birds called honeyguides work with humans.
sentences.ko: 꿀잡이새라고 불리는 새들은 인간과 함께 일한다.

sentences.title: Cooperating for Honey
sentences.en: But there are ones that are hard to break open.
sentences.ko: 하지만 부수어서 열기에 어려운 것들도 있다.

sentences.title: Cooperating for Honey
sentences.en: The humans return the call and then follow it.
sentences.ko: 인간들은 그 소리에 답한 다음 그것을 따라간다.
sentences.target: return the call and then follow it

sentences.title: Cooperating for Honey
sentences.en: When a honeyguide finds a bee nest, it calls out to nearby humans.
sentences.ko: 꿀잡이새가 벌집을 발견하면, 그것은 근처의 인간들을 향해 울음소리를 낸다.
sentences.target: When a honeyguide finds a bee nest

sentences.title: Cooperating for Honey
sentences.en: … are a great example of people who cooperate with honeyguides.

sentences.title: A Meal for Two
sentences.en: Helping someone in need doesn’t always have to cost you extra time or money.
sentences.ko: 어려움에 처한 누군가를 돕는 것에 항상 추가의 시간이나 돈이 드는 것은 아니다.

sentences.title: A Meal for Two
sentences.en: A charity organization named Mealshare lets you do exactly this!
sentences.ko: Mealshare라는 이름의 한 자선 단체가 당신으로 하여금 바로 이것을 하게 한다!

sentences.title: A Meal for Two
sentences.en: The money is used to give a meal to someone in need, at no extra cost to you!
sentences.ko: 당신이 아무런 추가 비용을 지불하지 않고도, 그 돈은 어려움에 처한 누군가에게 식사를 제공하는 데 쓰인다!

sentences.title: A Meal for Two
sentences.en: Mealshare was founded in Canada by business school graduates in 2013.
sentences.ko: Mealshare는 2013년 캐나다에서 경영 대학원 졸업생들에 의해 설립되었다.

sentences.title: A Meal for Two
sentences.en: They were unhappy that so many people …, so they wanted to create a convenient way for restaurant-goers to help others.
sentences.ko: 그들은 매우 많은 사람들이 … 마음이 좋지 않았고, 그래서 식당에 가는 사람들이 타인을 도울 수 있는 편리한 방법을 만들고 싶었다.

sentences.title: A Meal for Two
sentences.ko: 그리고 그 수는 계속 늘어나고 있다!

quiz.q: I lost my pen. I need to buy a new ____.
I bought a cap yesterday. I like ____ a lot.
These shoes are too small. Do you have bigger ____?
This sweater is as ____ as that one. (big)
Amy is as (tall / taller) as Tom.
Some bee nests are easy to open, but there are hard (one / ones), too.
This tea is as hotter as that tea.
quiz.a: This tea is as hot as that tea.

quiz.q: This car is as fast so that car.
quiz.a: This car is as fast as that car.
